customItems.name: The First Seed
customItems.description: A seed older than forests, light enough to carry and heavy enough to change a world.
customItems.customDescription: A seed older than forests, light enough to carry and heavy enough to change a world.

intro.text: Every forest in the region leans in the same direction overnight. Beneath the oldest grove, the Root of the First Forest has awakened and decided civilization was a pruning mistake.

outro.text: The First Seed remains after the root goes still. It does not demand worship or blood. It waits to see what kind of forest mercy makes.

storyTriggers.title: Last Axe Camp
storyTriggers.text: Axes are embedded in stumps, but the handles have grown leaves. The campfire is full of acorns.

storyTriggers.title: Ring of Seasons
storyTriggers.text: Four seasons turn around the ring at once. Snow falls onto blossoms. Autumn leaves land on new grass.

storyTriggers.title: Winter Root
storyTriggers.text: The winter root whispers names of things that survived by sleeping.

storyTriggers.title: Summer Root
storyTriggers.text: The summer root whispers names of things that survived by burning bright.

storyTriggers.title: Worldroot Heart
storyTriggers.text: The Root of the First Forest fills the chamber like a god remembering it used to be a seed.
